entries.title: Galatians 2:1
segments: ¶Then after a lapse of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with [me];

entries.title: Galatians 2:2
segments: and I went up according to revelation, and I laid before them the glad tidings which I preach among the nations, but privately to those conspicuous [among them], lest in any way I run or had run in vain;

entries.title: Galatians 2:3
segments: (but neither was Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, compelled to be circumcised;)

entries.title: Galatians 2:4
segments: and [it was] on account of the false brethren brought in surreptitiously, who came in surreptitiously to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

entries.title: Galatians 2:5
segments: to whom we yielded in subjection not even for an hour, that the truth of the glad tidings might remain with you.

entries.title: Galatians 2:6
segments: But from those who were conspicuous as being somewhat--whatsoever they were, it makes no difference to me: God does not accept man's person; for to me those who were conspicuous communicated nothing;

entries.title: Galatians 2:7
segments: but, on the contrary, seeing that the glad tidings of the uncircumcision were confided to me, even as to Peter that of the circumcision,

entries.title: Galatians 2:8
segments: (for he that wrought in Peter for [the] apostleship of the circumcision wrought also in me towards the Gentiles,)

entries.title: Galatians 2:9
segments: and recognising the grace given to me, James and Cephas and John, who were conspicuous as being pillars, gave to me and Barnabas [the] right hands of fellowship, that *we* [should go] to the nations, and *they* to the circumcision;

entries.title: Galatians 2:10
segments: only that we should remember the poor, which same thing also I was diligent to do.

entries.title: Galatians 2:11
segments: ¶But when Peter came to Antioch, I withstood him to [the] face, because he was to be condemned:

entries.title: Galatians 2:12
segments: for before that certain came from James, he ate with [those of] the nations; but when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those of [the] circumcision;

entries.title: Galatians 2:13
segments: and the rest of the Jews also played the same dissembling part with him; so that even Barnabas was carried away too by their dissimulation.

entries.title: Galatians 2:14
segments: But when I saw that they do not walk straightforwardly, according to the truth of the glad tidings, I said to Peter before all, If *thou*, being a Jew, livest as the nations and not as the Jews, how dost thou compel the nations to Judaize?

entries.title: Galatians 2:15
segments: We, Jews by nature, and not sinners of [the] nations,

entries.title: Galatians 2:16
segments: but knowing that a man is not justified on the principle of works of law [nor] but by the faith of Jesus Christ, *we* also have believed on Christ Jesus, that we might be justified on the principle of [the] faith of Christ; and not of works of law; because on the principle of works of law no flesh shall be justified.

entries.title: Galatians 2:17
segments: Now if in seeking to be justified in Christ we also have been found sinners, then [is] Christ minister of sin? Far be the thought.

entries.title: Galatians 2:18
segments: For if the things I have thrown down, these I build again, I constitute myself a transgressor.

entries.title: Galatians 2:19
segments: For *I*, through law, have died to law, that I may live to God.

entries.title: Galatians 2:20
segments: I am crucified with Christ, and no longer live, *I*, but Christ lives in me; but [in] that I now live in flesh, I live by faith, the [faith] of the Son of God, who has loved me and given himself for me.

entries.title: Galatians 2:21
segments: I do not set aside the grace of God; for if righteousness [is] by law, then Christ has died for nothing.
